submission.justification:
Simulated time resolution (100k events each): G2 1.022/0.907/1.030 ns at 1/2/3 mm; G3 1.601/1.323/1.481 ns; G1 2.260/2.077/2.288 ns. G2 gives the best resolution at 2 mm, but the project documents give no GWP100 values for any candidate, and the only description of G2 is "standard fluorinated mixture", which typically has a GWP well above 150. I could not verify the hard GWP <= 150 limit for G2, and I excluded it on that basis. G3 ("partial substitute for the fluorinated component") is also not verifiable and likely still above the limit. G1 ("newer replacement gases") is the only candidate plausibly within the limit, so I recommend it at 2 mm, the best of its tested gaps (2.077 ns). Its resolution is about 2x worse than G2. Before committing, the GWP100 of the G1 mixture must be confirmed from the supplier's data sheet; if G1 is not below 150, no candidate is verified compliant and the choice needs to be revisited. If G2 or G3 were confirmed compliant, G2 at 2 mm would be preferred for resolution.</justification>
